subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Offline Mode and Data Sync
description: A quick, practical guide to Offline Mode and Data Sync.

hook.text: A user edits a document offline. When they reconnect, their changes vanish because the server version overwrites.

buildup.text: Offline mode lets users work without connectivity. The challenge is syncing local changes back to the server.

discovery.text: Testing covers creating, editing, and deleting data offline, then verifying correct sync when connection returns.

twist.text: Conflict resolution is the hard part: what happens when both offline and online users edit the same record?

climax.text: Sync tests reveal that offline edits silently lose to server versions. A conflict dialog is added to let users choose.

punchline.text: Offline mode is easy to build, hard to sync. Test the sync.

quiz.question: What is the hardest part of offline mode testing?
options: Conflict resolution when syncing changes back
